signConventions.dt: t_CG(event) - t_truth(event) [s]; negative = the 3DCG shows the event earlier
signConventions.dS: -dt * v [m]; along-track position of the 3DCG minus the real car at the same instant; positive = 3DCG ahead
signConventions.dLat: CG distance-to-kerb minus true distance-to-kerb [m]; positive = the 3DCG shows the car farther from the kerb. For a kerb contact = CG gap at the truth onset (true gap 0).
signConventions.gap: inner tyre outer edge to the kerb line (T4/apex_kpi); negative = on the kerb
signConventions.L: video offset: true lap t of a frame = overlay-mapped lap t + L (T2)

labels.measured: directly from logger samples, video pixels/audio (by T1-T3) or the viewer pose re-run (T4)
labels.derived: arithmetic combination of measured values (differences, products with speed, statistics)
labels.estimated: depends on an assumption stated next to it (camera scale, physical model, line semantics)

timeBase.rule: video events -> true lap time with the per-lap offset L (adopted = T2 bestOffsetS: 7/30 video yaw vs gyro, measured; 7/29 data track + 7/30 calibration, estimated). Logger and CG events need no offset: T1 IMU/ECU and T4 share the GPS lap-t base.
